meta.name: accessibility-audit
meta.description: Audit any product surface against accessibility standards: WCAG 2.2 AA for web, Apple UIKit/SwiftUI Accessibility for iOS, Android TalkBack/AccessibilityService for Android, Microsoft UIA for Windows, AT-SPI for Linux, game-specific readability and remappable-controls patterns, and voice/chat AI surfaces with appropriate alternative modes. Produces a per-criterion status, automated test suggestions, manual test scripts, screen-reader transcripts, contrast measurements, and a release-gate verdict that names the fixed and outstanding findings. Use after ux-design and before release on every surface with user interaction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计产品无障碍合规性,产出整改清单与发布结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在准备发布产品,需要确认无障碍标准都达标
copy.tagline_en: Audit product accessibility and get a fix list with release verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to ship and need to confirm accessibility standards.

howto.what: 按平台适用的无障碍标准（如网页用 WCAG 2.2 AA）逐项审计界面，输出每项通过/关注/失败/不适用，附证据、屏幕阅读器实录、对比度测量、缺陷清单、修复计划，并给出发布门禁裁决（Go/Conditional/Hold）。
howto.when: 在 UX 设计完成之后、发布之前，对涉及用户交互的界面触发审计。

say.text: 审计这个网页的无障碍性，按 WCAG 2.2 AA 逐项给状态。
say.note: 得到带证据的状态表和发布裁决。

say.text: 给 iOS 应用做屏幕阅读器走查，给出 VoiceOver 实录。
say.note: 生成屏幕阅读器运行记录和问题清单。

say.text: 对游戏做可重映射控件确认，再给发布门禁裁决。

howto.what_en: Audits surfaces per platform accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA for web). Outputs per-criterion status, evidence, screen-reader transcripts, contrast measurements, findings, remediation plan, and release-gate verdict (Go/Conditional/Hold).
howto.when_en: Triggers after ux-design and before release, on every surface with user interaction, as stated in the skill description.

say_en.text: Audit this webpage for accessibility; give a status per WCAG 2.2 AA criterion.
say_en.note: Returns status table with evidence and release verdict.

say_en.text: Run a screen-reader walkthrough on our iOS app and give VoiceOver transcripts.
Confirm remappable controls for the game, then issue a release-gate verdict.
